00023 /**

00042

00048     kBtMsgAuthenticated         = 0x12,         /**< Profile authenticated */
00049     kBtMsgEncrypted             = 0x13,         /**< Profile encrypted */

00051     /* Power management notifications from connectivity manager*/
00052     kBtMsgSleep                 = 0x20,         /**< Sleep notification (plugin to daemon)*/
00053     kBtMsgWake                  = 0x21,         /**< Wakeup notification (plugin to daemon)*/
00054 
00055     /* pairing messages */
00056     kBtMsgPinCodeRequest        = 0x30,         /**< Send pin code request msg.  Sent by Bt Daemon*/
00057     kBtMsgPinCodeResponse       = 0x31,         /**< Pin code response message.  Sent by UI in response to Pin Code Request*/
00058

00065     kBtMsgGetSilentPairMode     = 0x35,         /**< Query sys app for it's pairing state */
00066

00068     kBtMsgSilentPairEnabled     = 0x36,         /**< Sys bar app reports silent pairing is enabled */
00069     kBtMsgSilentPairDisabled    = 0x37,         /**< Sys bar app reports silent pairing is disabled */
00070 
00071     kBtMsgPairingDialogDisplay  = 0x38,         /**< Sent to invoke Pairing dialog */
00072     kBtMsgPairingDialogClosed   = 0x39,         /**< Sent to inform that pairing dialog is closed */
00073 
00074     /* Radio management messages */
00075     kBtMsgRequestRadioOff       = 0x40,         /**< Message sent by application requesting radio off   */
00076     kBtMsgRequestRadioOn        = 0x41,         /**< Message sent by application requesting radio on    */
00077     kBtMsgRadioOff              = 0x42,         /**< Message sent by Daemon that Bluetooth radio is off */

00084     kBtMsgLoaded                = 0x51,         /**< Message sent by Daemon when Bluetooth stack finished loading. */

00086     kBtMsgDiscoverable          = 0x70,         /**< Message sent by Daemon when device is set to discoverable */

00090     kBtMsgNonDiscoveryComplete  = 0x74,         /**< Message sent by btmgr to vis mgr when discover change has completed */
